repo_meta_data.description: One memory shared by Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot CLI, OpenClaw and 29 more coding agents, built from the session history already on disk. A fix found in one agent comes back in any of them, including months of sessions from before you installed it. No LLM, no embeddings, one local Go binary.
